relevant_files.role: Language registration hub; defines LanguageInfo struct and get_language_info() match arms for all supported languages
Reference implementation for a full-featured language with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, and extraction handlers
Minimal language implementation (no inheritance handlers); template for languages with limited semantic features
Workspace dependency declarations for tree-sitter language crates
Workspace-level dependency pins for tree-sitter and language crates
Integration test patterns for language support (test_java_parse_and_extract, test_javascript_parse_and_extract)

conventions.commits: Conventional commits with signed tags (git tag -s vX.Y.Z); DCO required
conventions.testing: Unit tests in language modules (mod.rs and individual language files); integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/integration_tests.rs; table-driven tests for language metadata
conventions.linting: cargo clippy -- -D warnings; undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used all denied; test-code exemptions via cfg_attr
conventions.error_handling: thiserror for error types; Result<T> return types; no panics in library code; SAFETY comments required for unsafe blocks

patterns: Each language has a dedicated module (e.g., crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs) with const query strings and optional extraction handlers
ELEMENT_QUERY captures function, method, class, interface, trait, and enum declarations with @function and @class tags
CALL_QUERY captures function/method invocations with @call tag
DEFUSE_QUERY (optional) captures variable definitions and uses with @write.* and @read.* tags for semantic analysis
extract_inheritance() walks AST to find extends/implements relationships; returns Vec<String> of base class/interface names
Language registration in mod.rs via get_language_info() match arm; must include all LanguageInfo fields
File extension mapping in lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP; case-insensitive lookup via language_for_extension()
Tree-sitter language crate dependency added to workspace Cargo.toml; imported in mod.rs as tree_sitter_<lang>::LANGUAGE
constraints: No web search available; must use Context7 for tree-sitter-php grammar documentation
All languages unconditionally compiled in; no feature gates after removal of lang-* features
Parameter surface is strict: tool schema is the contract; no legacy fields, no silently ignored inputs
Rust edition 2024; async with tokio; latest MCP protocol via rmcp
CI runs on ubuntu-26.04-arm (ARM64); all tests must pass on that platform
test_coverage: Existing language modules have unit tests for ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, and extraction handlers (extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance). Integration tests in integration_tests.rs verify end-to-end parsing and extraction for each language. Table-driven tests in mod.rs verify language metadata consistency (reference_query, import_query presence). New PHP support must include: (1) unit tests for each query constant and handler in php.rs; (2) integration test in integration_tests.rs covering functions, methods, classes, interfaces, traits, enums, imports, and inheritance; (3) extension mapping test in lang.rs.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE constant; grammar supports function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration nodes; base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) as child nodes, not fields
library_findings.notes: PHP grammar uses base_clause and class_interface_clause as sibling nodes to class_declaration, not field names. The class_declaration node has only three fields: attributes, body (declaration_list), and name. Inheritance walk must iterate children of class_declaration to find base_clause and class_interface_clause nodes, then extract names from their children.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter::Query for tree-sitter query strings; tree_sitter::Node for AST traversal; child_by_field_name(), named_child(), parent(), kind() methods
library_findings.notes: Query strings use S-expression syntax; capture names are @-prefixed identifiers. Field names are matched via child_by_field_name(). Inheritance extraction requires manual tree traversal since PHP grammar does not expose extends/implements as fields.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Full PHP Support with All Handlers (Recommended)
approaches.description: Create crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (functions, methods, classes, interfaces, traits, enums), CALL_QUERY (method/function calls), REFERENCE_QUERY (type references), IMPORT_QUERY (use statements), DEFUSE_QUERY (variable definitions and uses), and all four extraction handlers (extract_function_name, find_method_for_receiver, find_receiver_type, extract_inheritance). Register in mod.rs get_language_info() and get_ts_language() match arms. Add .php and .phtml extensions to lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP. Add tree-sitter-php to workspace Cargo.toml. Add pub mod php to mod.rs. Write unit tests in php.rs and integration test in integration_tests.rs.
pros: Achieves feature parity with Java and C# implementations
Enables full semantic analysis: inheritance tracking, method resolution, def-use chains
Supports all PHP declaration kinds: functions, methods, classes, interfaces, traits, enums
DEFUSE_QUERY enables variable tracking for code comprehension tasks
Extraction handlers support receiver type and method name resolution for IDE-like features
cons: Highest implementation effort: requires writing all query strings and four handler functions
Largest code footprint (~300-400 LOC in php.rs)

approaches.name: Approach 2: Minimal PHP Support (Elements + Calls + Imports Only)
approaches.description: Create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, and REFERENCE_QUERY only. Omit DEFUSE_QUERY and all extraction handlers (set to None in LanguageInfo). Register in mod.rs and lang.rs as in Approach 1. Suitable for codebases that only need symbol extraction without semantic analysis.
pros: Covers 80% of use cases (symbol extraction, imports, basic call graph)
Simpler testing: only query validation tests needed
Faster to ship; can be extended later
cons: No inheritance tracking or def-use analysis
No method resolution by receiver type
Limited semantic comprehension for complex PHP codebases

approaches.name: Approach 3: PHP Support with DEFUSE_QUERY but No Handlers
approaches.description: Create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, and DEFUSE_QUERY. Omit all four extraction handlers (set to None). Provides def-use analysis without method resolution or inheritance tracking.
pros: Enables variable tracking and def-use chains for comprehension
Covers more use cases than Approach 2 without full complexity of Approach 1

recommendation: Approach 1 (Full PHP Support with All Handlers). PHP is a mature language with widespread use in web development; users integrating aptu-coder into PHP codebases will expect feature parity with Java and C#. The DEFUSE_QUERY and extraction handlers are essential for accurate code comprehension in object-oriented PHP (classes, interfaces, traits, inheritance). The implementation effort is justified by the completeness of the solution and consistency with existing language integrations. The test coverage requirements ensure reliability across PHP's diverse syntax (heredoc strings, anonymous classes, enums, traits).

pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,

    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,

    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}

r"
(function_definition
  name: (name) @func_name) @function
(method_declaration
  name: (name) @method_name) @function
(class_declaration
  name: (name) @class_name) @class
(interface_declaration

inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-php grammar (common/define-grammar.js and php/src/node-types.json): A class_declaration node has three fields (attributes, body, name) and two optional child node types (base_clause and class_interface_clause). To extract inheritance: (1) call child_by_field_name('name') on the class_declaration to get the class name; (2) iterate node.child_count() and examine each child's kind(): if kind() == 'base_clause', iterate its named_child_count() and collect each named_child(i).kind() == 'name' as an extends relationship; (3) if kind() == 'class_interface_clause', iterate its named children and collect each name as an implements relationship. The base_clause and class_interface_clause nodes are not fields but sibling children in the tree.
